newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: US chemicals group Witco sets up base in Geneva.
newsitem.headline: US chemicals group Witco sets up base in Geneva.

text.p: Witco Corp, the U.S. maker of speciality chemicals, will base its headquarters for Europe, Africa and the Near East in Geneva as part of a restructuring plan, city officials said on Wednesday.

The group will also establish its marketing and research centre for Europe, Africa and the Near East in Geneva, where it acquired a Swiss chemicals company, OSI Specialities SA, in 1995, they told the Swiss news agency ATS.

Witco, which produces speciality chemicals for makers of cosmetics, household, automotive, agricultural, packaging and food products, announced plans in December to consolidate its 46 manufacturing facilities into 31 facilities and cut 1,800 jobs under a three-year restructuring plan.
